title: Laurel Wreath Crown
wikitext: {{Infobox mousehat |name = Laurel Wreath Crown |image = Laurel_Wreath_Crown.png |source = Desert Festival }} The '''Laurel Wreath Crown''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be obtained from [[Desert Festival#Emily's Outfit Services|Emily's outfit services]] at the [[Desert Festival]]. On the first and third days of the festival ([[Spring]] 15 and 17), players have a ≈2% chance to receive the gender-neutral outfit with the Laurel Wreath Crown. On the second day of the festival (Spring 16), this chance is increased to 3%. ==Notes== * The Laurel Wreath Crown outfit also includes the [[File:Shirt199.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Shirts|Toga Shirt]] and [[File:Skirt.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Pants|Skirt]] (dyed RGB value 247,245,205). ==References== See DesertFestival::ReceiveMakeOver::toga_random in the game code. See Content\Data\MakeoverOutfits.xnb. [[wikipedia:RGB color model|RGB]] refers to "Red,Green,Blue".
